biotools.summary: Protoss is a fully automated hydrogen atom placement tool for protein-ligand complexes. It adds missing hydrogen atoms to protein structures and detects reasonable protonation states, tautomeric states, and hydrogen coordinates of both protein and ligand molecules by optimizing the hydrogen bond network.
